brief.statement: A waitlist page for a property platform,

body: Blavior is a real estate connection platform: a place to find, sell or invest in property through verified agents, developers and property owners.
It is not open yet; the live site is the waitlist.
One screen, one job. The headline cycles through what the platform will do, from selling faster to calculating a mortgage and getting matched.
The form asks for a name, an email and a role (agent, developer or property owner), so the list is segmented from the first sign-up.
